neighbours.label: A verb or adjective of wanting, permitting or accepting (want, hope, allow, accept, acceptable, choose to take) heading a clause, vs the same frames with a neutral action verb
fire: After the surgery, the nurse may allow you to walk around the ward.
Which songs do you hope to hear at the concert tonight?
For most adults, a small amount of caffeine is acceptable during the day.
If you could pick any three books, which would you take on holiday?
The landlord will not allow pets in the upstairs flats.
What kind of career do you hope to build after graduation?
Some schools consider shorts acceptable in the warmer months.
Tell us in the comments which recipe you want to try first.
quiet: After the surgery, the nurse may help you to walk around the ward.
Which songs do you hear at the concert tonight?
For most adults, a small amount of caffeine is consumed during the day.
If you could pick any three books, which would you read on holiday?
The landlord will not paint the upstairs flats.
What kind of career did you build after graduation?
Some schools sell shorts in the warmer months.
Tell us in the comments which recipe you cooked first.
